impact: A core print of 0.3% or more would harden December hike bets and pressure growth holdings; a soft print extends the rebound.
summary: The BLS releases October CPI at 8:30am ET Tuesday Nov 10. Consensus is +0.3% headline and +0.2% core month on month; the Cleveland Fed nowcast is 0.24% and 0.21%. No year-over-year figures will be published because October 2025 data was not collected during the shutdown.
title: October CPI due Tuesday: 0.3% headline, 0.2% core expected
